name: Gahz'rilla
label: Quest
description: Gahz'rilla: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Deep in Zul'Farrak, the sand troll city in Tanaris, there is a sacred pool. From that pool the trolls summon a huge beast! Gahz'rilla! He's so fierce that even his scales crackle with energy. It's that energy I want to harness for my car!
Bring me the electrified scale of Gahz'rilla!
But the summoning of Gahz'rilla is a well-kept secret of the trolls. To face him, you must first wrest the secret from them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the scale? I can't wait to try different ways to harness its energy!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wow, you got the scale! Thanks, friend. I can't wait to get to work on this thing!
So you saw Gahz'rilla? Was he as big as they say??
